identity.title: [Runtime v3] Make kernel wiring, contracts, and supervision authoritative

values.goal: Resolve all ten confirmed Runtime v3 kernel architecture findings with enforced contracts and executable proof.
values.required_outcome: Runtime v3 rejects invalid wiring before spawn, enforces determinism and backpressure, starts and stops by dependency layer, supervises failures with bounded policy, and exposes truthful aggregate health.
declared_scope: focused kernel tests and bounded architecture documentation
authority_boundary: Issue #471 owns only Runtime v3 kernel contract and proof surfaces
WP-27 issue #315 remains untouched and unmerged
No cloud, provider, distributed consensus, or Runtime v4 authority
Existing valid Runtime assemblies remain supported through an explicit contract migration
operator_constraints: Prefer the simplest truthful kernel-owned mechanism
Use typed C-SDLC v2 in a bound FastWork worktree
Obtain independent exact-head review before publication
